sn51.26:2.1: Katame sattaphalā sattānisaṃsā || || Diṭṭheva dhamme paṭihacca aññam ārādheti || || No ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭihacca aññam ārādheti || atha maraṇakāle aññam ārādheti || || No ce maraṇakāle aññam ārādheti || atha pañcannam orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānam parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti || upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti || asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti || sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hotī || uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ime sattaphalā sattānisaṃsā patikaṅkhā ti || ||
